BEAULIEU GARDEN

Paula LeDuc Fine Catering & Events’ exclusive event property, Beaulieu Garden, is a multi-generational private estate and one of Napa Valley’s oldest premium quality wine-producing vineyards that has been the backdrop for iconic celebrations and social events for cultural icons, presidents and dignitaries, business moguls and celebrity clients. Beaulieu Garden offers the charm of a rich, historical property, that is private and immersed in nature - the idyllic setting for connection and celebration. 


Guided by our concierge event management team, clients will have all-encompassing access to Beaulieu’s remarkable site features. Guests are welcomed into the historic estate with a quarter-mile drive that is dappled with sycamore trees. From there, the team helps clients architect an effortless event in some of the most beautiful spaces this property has to offer, including the dramatic sunken garden with old stone fountains, to the arbor and vineyard with rolling hills seen for miles. 

LIMITLESS POTENTIAL, EXCLUSIVE USE

From social parties to corporate retreats, executive-level private dinners, workshops, brand events, editorial, and commercial use - Beaulieu Garden offers clients a beautiful, private space with a turn-key service team to help you utilize the space to its fullest. While Beaulieu Garden itself does not offer overnight accommodations, we have partnered with esteemed local hospitality groups and properties to guarantee a seamless lodging experience for all of our guests.

OUR CULINARY AND FLORAL GARDEN

The estate’s garden and orchard uses biodynamic planting methods dating back to the French ancestry of the property, yielding produce and fresh herbs that led to collaborations with culinary luminaries like James Beard and Julia Child. Fast forward to today, we continue to tend to the garden and source many of our seasonal ingredients from its soil. We look to the garden for inspiration and incorporate those ingredients into our menus whenever we can. Additionally, as of 2022,  our Chief Creative Officer, Kathleen Deery, started a cutting garden from which she can source flowers for projects throughout the Summer. We feel that by continuing this tradition of farming we can continue our message that the best tasting and most nutritional food is organically grown and harvested in ways that are ecologically sound.
